prompt.en: Who founded the women's suffrage movement in Canada?
prompt.fr: Qui a fondé le mouvement pour le droit de vote des femmes au Canada?

options.en: Dr. Emily Stowe, the first Canadian woman to practise medicine in Canada.
options.fr: La docteure Emily Stowe, première Canadienne à pratiquer la médecine au Canada.

options.en: Agnes Macphail, the first woman MP, elected in 1921.
options.fr: Agnes Macphail, première femme députée, élue en 1921.

options.en: Thérèse Casgrain, whose work won Quebec women the vote in 1940.
options.fr: Thérèse Casgrain, dont le travail a valu le vote aux Québécoises en 1940.

options.en: Mary Ann Shadd Carey, who in 1853 became the first woman publisher in Canada.
options.fr: Mary Ann Shadd Carey, qui est devenue en 1853 la première femme éditrice au Canada.

explanation.en: Dr. Emily Stowe started the campaign for women's votes in this country. She was also the first woman here to work as a doctor. Macphail and Casgrain belong to later chapters of the same story.
explanation.fr: C'est la docteure Emily Stowe qui a lancé la campagne pour le vote des femmes au pays. Elle a aussi été la première femme d'ici à exercer la médecine. Macphail et Casgrain appartiennent à des chapitres ultérieurs de la même histoire.

source.quote: Its founder in Canada was Dr. Emily Stowe, the first Canadian woman to practise medicine in Canada.

verification.evidence: The effort by women to achieve the right to vote is known as the women’s suffrage movement. Its founder in Canada was Dr. Emily Stowe, the first Canadian woman to practise medicine in Canada.
